zomi: A kipat cilin Pasian in vantung le leitung a piangsak hi.
en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

zomi: Pasian in, "Khuavak om hen," ci hi; tua ciangin khuavak om pah hi.
en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

zomi: Pasian in khuavak pen "Sun" ci a, khuamial pen "Zan" ci hi. Nitak hong beiin, zingsang hong tung a, ni khat ni ahi hi.
en: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night.

zomi: Pasian in, "Eima lim, eimah hong sunin mihing bawl ni. Tuipi ngasate tung, huihlak vasate tung, ganhingte tung, le leitung a a bokvakte khempeuh tungah ukna neisak ni," a ci hi.
en: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness.

zomi: Pasian in ama lim bangin mihing piangsakin, Pasian' lim bangin amah a piangsak hi. Amah in pasal le numei a piangsak hi.
en: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

zomi: Topa Pasian in mipa samin ama kiangah, "Koi laiah om na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

zomi: Topa in Kain tungah, "Na sanggampa Abel koiah om ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
en: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother?

zomi: Noah a thuman mi khat hi a, ama khangah paubaang lo hi. Noah pen Pasian tawh kikhawl hi.
en: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

zomi: Koi laiah om na hi hiam?
Tua laitakin leitung buppi in kampau khat le kammal tawmno bek nei hi.
en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

zomi: Na gam, na beh, le na pa' inn panin nang kong lah ding gamah pai in.
en: Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
